summary: Flamefall is an advanced, AI-powered analysis and fire-safety infographics dashboard designed to help with safety of spacecraft and extraterrestrial operations. Addressing the critical microgravity combustion challenge, Flamefall processes official NASA experimental Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) combustion datasets from investigation records and and predicts flammability limits, material behavior, and suppression dynamics. Utilizing automated data indexing, multi-language LLM analysis, and real-time visualization tools, the platform bridges raw scientific data with actionable engineering insights for future missions to the Moon and Mars as well as Earth orbit, where elevated oxygen and reduced pressure increases fire risks. Flamefall helps researchers, engineers, and students to evaluate combustion hazards with ease, establishing a reliable standard for active aerospace fire prevention and safety applications.
details: What Does Flamefall Do? Flamefall is an interactive, AI-powered fire-safety intelligence dashboard built for the NASA Space Apps 2026 "Flame in Freefall" challenge. It aggregates, structures, and analyzes NASA’s Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) microgravity and ground combustion records including major experiments such as BASS, Saffire, FLEX, ACME, SAME, and DAFT to evaluate fire prevention, smoke detection, and extinguishment strategies in spacecraft and extraterrestrial enviroments.
